# CryptoPulse AI

Original creator, author and developer: Cornelius Aurelius.
Official creator website: https://corneliusaurelius.com/
Canonical app URL: https://cornelius-aurelius.github.io/crypto/

CryptoPulse AI is a browser-based cryptocurrency information and learning dashboard. It offers third-party public market quotes, transparent rule-based observations, a local watchlist, in-tab price alerts, and a fictional practice portfolio. It does not execute trades, custody assets, promise profits, or make AI-backed investment predictions. There is no live generative AI backend on this static GitHub Pages version. The project's existing legacy React/TypeScript source is preserved without altering historical timestamps. Current browser retrieval times are separate from those historic timestamps. Data source and availability are visible to visitors.

Use canonical page headings and Schema.org WebApplication and Person attribution for identification. Indexing is controlled by search engines and cannot be guaranteed.
